unidentified-3d011bbb-snark-verifier.title: Not affected: EOA 0x3d011bbb… only sent plain ETH transfers to precompile addresses; no SNARK verification

unidentified-c6fd8084-p256.title: Address-poisoning batch contract 0xc6fd8084: its calls to the P-256 precompile are a calldata-parsing artefact; it verifies no signature (not affected)

unidentified-e11be20b-signer-key.title: Unidentified EIP-7702 wallet co-signer verifier 0xe11be20b: requires both the account's own key and a service key, so a recovered service key alone moves nothing

uniswap-permit2-code-first.title: Uniswap Permit2 (canonical and one copy): signatures from accounts with code go to ERC-1271 with the full signature; no exposure beyond each account's own key

velora-delta-order-code-first.title: Velora Delta (Portikus adapter): user orders are checked through ERC-1271 for accounts with real code, so a post-quantum account is not forgeable here; not affected beyond the account's own key
